items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: He was the clarinet player in the Olympia band when they first started... I think he went back to the Imperial with Manuel... George Baquet went with the Olympia.

ctx.x: George Baquet was clarinet. Was it an Olympia band? No, Big Eye Louie?

items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: I think Tats' daddy was playing trombone. Alexander, yeah. Alexander. He played trombone.

ctx.x: Would it have been a Baptiste, a Leo, by any chance?

That's it. He was a trombone player with them. And oh, I think Tats' daddy was playing trombone. Alexander, yeah. Alexander. He played trombone. Playing trombone. Oh yeah, I thought he was an outdoor player. In the later years he was taking a foul. He played trombone right there. And she was playing, I think Rene Baptiste was playing guitar.
